item.title: SUNshine Girl Bella
item.description: SUNshine Girl Bella likes playing pool and darts, swimming, and taking her daughter shopping. The 5-foot-1 Capricorn enjoys posing for photoshoots. Her dream car is a 1967 Chevy Impala. These photos were taken in May 2018. (Jack Boland/Toronto Sun)
